overview_description.description: NEARMOTION is an innovative technology company specializing in indoor navigation solutions through interactive digital maps and augmented reality (AR). Their state-of-the-art platform empowers users to navigate complex indoor environments, like malls, airports, and large corporate campuses, with ease and precision. By harnessing the power of AR, NEARMOTION enhances the user experience, overlaying digital information onto the physical world to guide visitors directly to their destinations. Their services are designed not only for wayfinding but also for engaging customer interactions, offering businesses a unique tool to connect with their audience. As a leader in the indoor navigation space, NEARMOTION is at the forefront of blending the digital with the physical, providing intuitive and seamless experiences for users worldwide.

product.name: Indoor Navigation
product.description: A system that provides step-by-step guidance inside buildings using interactive digital floor maps and positioning technology.

product.name: Digital Mapping
product.description: Creation of interactive 2D and 3D digital indoor floor maps with defined points of interest and connected routes for navigation.

product.name: Real-Time Tracking and Asset Management
product.description: A system to monitor the real-time location of assets and staff within indoor venues, enabling efficient resource management and incident response.

product.name: Location-Based Visitor Engagement
product.description: A platform that delivers location-specific information, offers, and notifications to visitors based on their indoor position.

product.name: Beacon Network Setup and Management
product.description: Provision and management of Bluetooth Low Energy beacon networks to enable indoor positioning and location-based services.
